decision: Use refined concise prompts in the existing default workflow. Keep joint Filter/Resolve behind the explicit experimental Python/HTTP entry point; do not change the UI workflow.
checked_invariants: All 50 original IDs, ranks, scores and retrieval provenance were identical across arms for every paired ticket in both rounds.
Every released historical source belonged to the surviving primary/active selection; procedures had active historical comment citations.
Exact current quotations and conditional source checks were preserved by the server.
No action or assignment was authorized; failed joint drafts were withheld without retry.
Recorded calls were exactly three per baseline/compact ticket and two per fast ticket; zero reasoning tokens.

protocol.schedule: Each ticket runs all three arms sequentially in rotating order; first ticket alone, then bounded concurrent tickets. Encoder load excluded.

arms.fast: Clean parallel with retrieval and joint Filter/Resolve, two calls; post-reconciliation validation

protocol.evaluation: Public development cases; no answer annotations in inference. One paired pass, not GT accuracy or a production latency guarantee.

review_findings.finding: An inferred dashboard refresh/propagation failure was marked satisfied; source facts establish a stale overview, not the mechanism.

initial.review_scope: Assistant qualitative inspection of all 20 cases across the three arms, against original narrative and returned evidence. Findings are not independent human labels or GT scores.
initial.decision: Do not promote the first compact prompts on latency alone. Preserve qualifiers and missing identifiers, then rerun all 20 cases in all arms.

limitations: The same 20 public development cases were reused after qualitative inspection and prompt refinement. These are not held-out or GT accuracy results.
Ready counts measure schema, citation membership and pipeline checks, not business correctness. Semantic errors can pass them.
Assistant qualitative review is not independent human annotation; case-level notes are in docs/LATENCY_EXPERIMENT.md.
